title: Why Zepto loses money on every order #shorts

segments.text: Zepto delivers your milk in ten minutes, and loses money doing it.
Every dark store costs lakhs in rent, staff and cold storage.
On a two hundred rupee order, the margin barely covers the rider.
So why keep going? Because habits are the real product.
Once you stop visiting the kirana, they can raise fees slowly.

loop_line: And that's exactly why that ten minute delivery feels so cheap.
description: How quick commerce economics really work. #zepto #business #india
